original_value: Interpretable multi-hop reading comprehension (RC) over multiple documents is a challenging problem because it demands reasoning over multiple information sources and explaining the answer prediction by providing supporting evidences. In this paper, we propose an effective and interpretable Select, Answer and Explain (SAE) system to solve the multi-document RC problem. Our system first filters out answer-unrelated documents and thus reduce the amount of distraction information. This is achieved by a document classifier trained with a novel pairwise learning-to-rank loss. The selected answer-related documents are then input to a model to jointly predict the answer and supporting sentences. The model is optimized with a multi-task learning objective on both token level for answer prediction and sentence level for supporting sentences prediction, together with an attention-based interaction between these two tasks. Evaluated on HotpotQA, a challenging multi-hop RC data set, the proposed SAE system achieves top competitive performance in distractor setting compared to other existing systems on the leaderboard.

result.paraphrase: Interpretable multi-hop reading comprehension across multiple documents is challenging because it requires reasoning over several information sources and explaining predictions with supporting evidence. In this paper, we present an effective, interpretable Select, Answer and Explain (SAE) system for the multi-document RC task. The system first removes documents unrelated to the answer, reducing distracting information. It does this with a document classifier trained using a novel pairwise learning-to-rank loss. The remaining answer-relevant documents are then fed into a model that jointly predicts the answer and supporting sentences. This model is optimized with a multi-task learning objective at both the token level for answer prediction and the sentence level for supporting-sentence prediction, along with attention-based interaction between the two tasks. On HotpotQA, a challenging multi-hop RC dataset, the proposed SAE system attains top competitive performance in the distractor setting compared with other systems on the leaderboard.
